Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 1250 PM EDT Tue Oct 13 2026

- Breezy with well above normal warmth today.

- Scattered showers tonight into tomorrow south of I-69.

- Turning more seasonable tomorrow into Thursday with additional 
  rainfall Thursday afternoon into Thursday night.

- Strong cold front brings more windy conditions Friday as 
  conditions becomes chillier Friday night into Saturday.

&&

.AVIATION...

Southwest to west winds gusting 20 to 30 knots early this afternoon 
will drop off quickly and veer to the northwest to north this 
evening. MVFR clouds over northern Lower Michigan will gradually 
settle south tonight, enhanced by some shower development over 
southern Lower Michigan. A slight chance of a thunderstorm exists 
over the southern tafs as well, but chances are too low too include. 
Low clouds around tomorrow morning are expected to mix out during 
the afternoon as subsidence and drier air settles into the area with 
light northerly flow. 

D21/DTW Convection...A passing wave to the south as a weak cold 
front sags through tonight offers a low chance for isolated thunder; 
however probability at the airport is too low to mention in TAF.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* Low for thunderstorms tonight.
